claim: For a One Zone file system, which supports only a single mount target, you can avoid data transfer charges between Availability Zones by accessing it from an EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone as the mount target; in the AWS example, an EC2 instance in a different Availability Zone pays EC2 data access charges for accessing the mount target.

values.display: avoid data transfer charges between Availability Zones

evidence.quote: You can avoid data transfer charges between Availability Zones and achieve better performance by accessing an EFS file system using an Amazon EC2 compute instance that is located in the same Availability Zone as that of the file system's mount target.
In this example, the EC2 instance in the us-west-2c Availability Zone will pay EC2 data access charges for accessing a mount target in a different Availability Zone.
